# FaithCraft

> FaithCraft is a Christian digital marketing and AI strategy agency helping churches, ministries, Christian businesses, creators, and faith-driven entrepreneurs improve visibility, trust, lead generation, websites, branding, content, and marketing workflows.

Canonical site: https://faithcraft.agency/
Contact: kal@faithcraft.agency

## Entity and positioning

FaithCraft combines Christian digital marketing, web design, branding, lead generation, content strategy, and human-directed AI workflows. The agency serves faith-driven organizations and entrepreneurs and emphasizes clear messaging, responsible stewardship of technology, human judgment, and measurable digital growth.
